name: dev.x402fi/x402fi
title: x402Fi
description: Find paid x402 APIs on Robinhood Chain and get the exact USDG payment for a call. Never pays.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the paid x402 APIs listed on x402Fi (Robinhood Chain, priced per call in USDG). Every word of the query must match. Returns endpoints with their price, method and payee name; use get_listing for how to call one.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'stock risk' or 'rug check'. Omit to list everything.

category.description: Exact category, e.g. 'AI & agents' or 'Developer tools'.

max_price_usd.description: Only endpoints whose price (or price ceiling) is at most this, in USD, e.g. '0.05'.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing's details: every live endpoint with its URL, method, price and how to call it (query params, path params, JSON body, example output), plus the payee name, settled-call count and the payout wallet's Priors credit record.

listing.description: The listing slug, e.g. 'stockfi-trade' (the `listing` field from search_services).

tools.name: get_payment_requirements
tools.description: The exact x402 402 (price, USDG asset, payTo, network, extensions) for one specific request to an x402Fi endpoint, without paying or calling the paid endpoint. Quoted endpoints are priced for this exact request. Sign the returned `accepts[0]` with the user's own wallet, then send the request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (a seller's own v1 endpoint reads X-PAYMENT instead: see `payment_header` in the result).

url.description: The full request URL including any query string, e.g. https://x402fi.dev/g/stockfi-trade/v1/preflight?symbol=AAPL

body.description: JSON body for POST/PUT/PATCH, as a string.
